description.en: Turns a low-detail cutscene character model to a given absolute Y-axis rotation over a number of frames.
Handle of the character model to turn.
Number of frames the turn should take.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Turn a character to face a specific rotation over 30 frames
EvLowMdlSetRotY(hTenmaL, -180, 30);
